credits.name: AGENTS.md
credits.evidence: Same shape and adoption model: one plain Markdown convention any agent can follow with no SDK. SPEC.md section 1 opens with it: AGENTS.md tells an agent how to behave, TRACES.md tells it how to leave a record. The README, site title and description follow the agents.md wording ('a simple, open format for ...').
